text: Real Madrid are keeping tabs on Scott McTominay's contract talks at Napoli , with the Spanish giants interested in signing the 29-year-old Scotland midfielder at the end of the season. (Tuttomercato)
Manchester United are unlikely to now bring McTominay back to Old Trafford as they are targeting younger signings. (Football Insider)

Bayern Munich want to extend 24-year-old France winger Michael Olise's contract, which runs until 2029, and it is likely he will stay with the German club unless a move to Real Madrid materialises. (Sky Sports Germany)

Manchester United have made attacking midfielder JJ Gabriel, 16, an official scholarship contract offer but could get only £350,000 for him if he decides not to stay at the club and moves abroad. (Guardian)

Chelsea are keen on signing Barcelona and Netherlands midfielder Frenkie de Jong, 29, as a belated replacement for Enzo Fernandez, who moved to Manchester City on transfer deadline day. (Sport - in Spanish)

Liverpool have a £59.5m buyback clause for Bayer Leverkusen defender Jarell Quansah, 23, but the England international - who has been linked with Real Madrid and Chelsea - is reluctant to return to Anfield. (Football Insider)

Juventus have doubts over 24-year-old Germany striker Nick Woltemade, who is on loan at the club from Newcastle United , and are looking at alternatives, including 25-year-old Monaco and United States forward Folarin Balogun. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Newcastle and Everton are both keen on Galatasaray midfielder Gabriel Sara. The 27-year-old Brazil midfielder spent two years with Norwich City before moving to Turkey. (Webaslan)
Hull City are close to signing Deniz Donmezer, an 18-year-old goalkeeper at Turkish side Kayserispor , for a fee of £1.5m. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are expected to face serious competition from rivals Liverpool for Bournemouth and France left-back Adrien Truffert, 24, who is valued at about £60m (Teamtalk)
Brazil and Athletico Paranaense defender Arthur Dias, 19, is being tracked by Barcelona having previously attracted an £18m bid from Tottenham . (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Newcastle United are favourites to beat Nottingham Forest to the signing of Lyon midfielder Tyler Morton. The 23-year-old is impressing in France after leaving Liverpool last year. (Football Insider)
Liverpool , Chelsea and Arsenal are all monitoring England defender Jarell Quansah as the 23-year-old continues to impress for Bayer Leverkusen . (Caught Offside)
Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard, 27, is expected to join manager Mikel Arteta in signing a new long-term contract at the Emirates. (Teamtalk)

Arsenal are ready to make a fresh attempt to lure Julian Alvarez, 26, to north London in January, with the Atletico Madrid and Argentina striker now seriously considering a move to the Gunners. (Teamtalk)
Former Real Madrid full-back Dani Carvajal remains a free agent after the 34-year-old's move to Getafe collapsed. (Goal)
Bundesliga giants Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund are keen on Tottenham youngster Luca Williams-Barnett, who made his Spurs debut at the age of 16. (Sun)
Aston Villa are ready to strike a loan deal for Brazil forward Endrick after the 20-year-old failed to impress Real Madrid boss Jose Mourinho. (Cadena SER - in Spanish)
Paris St-Germain and Liverpool are interested in signing Rayan Cherki from Manchester City should the 23-year-old France midfielder become available. (Teamtalk)
Ajax's Dutch defender Aaron Bouwman, 19, is on a list of young players Newcastle are monitoring before the next two transfer windows. (Newcastle Chronicle)
Arsenal are serious contenders for the signature of Club Tijuana's 17-year-old Mexican attacking midfielder Gilberto Mora. (Teamtalk)
Bournemouth have no intention of selling England midfielder Alex Scott, 23, in January despite interest from Chelsea and Real Madrid . (Talksport)
Real Madrid have already scouted Scott at least three times with Liverpool , Arsenal and AC Milan also keen. (4-4-2.ch - in German)
Antonio Rudiger, 33, looks set to leave Real Madrid at the end of the season with no plans to offer the Germany defender a new contract. (Sports Mole)
Tottenham will prioritise a striker in the January transfer window but are unlikely to spend big money. (Football Insider)
Real Madrid and Barcelona are ready to offer Manchester United attacking midfielder JJ Gabriel, 15, a substantial salary, bonuses and signing-on fee. (Florian Plettenberg)
Bayern Munich are not giving up hope of signing Gabriel but are unwilling to meet the seven-figure salary demanded by the Manchester United player's camp. (Times - subscription required)
Bayern are also monitoring Newcastle goalkeeper Nick Pope as the 34-year-old's contract is set to run out next summer. (Football Insider)
Atletico Madrid and Juventus are targeting 24-year-old Arsenal and England forward Noni Madueke. (Telegraph - requires subscription)

Chelsea , Arsenal , Liverpool , Manchester United and Manchester City are all interested in 27-year-old Barcelona and France defender Jules Kounde, with the Spanish club willing to listen to significant offers. (Sport - in Spanish)

AC Milan could make another attempt to sign Manchester United 's 25-year-old Dutch forward Joshua Zirkzee in January, potentially on loan with an option to buy. (Calciomercato - in Italian)

Representatives from clubs in the Premier League and Major League Soccer have been scouting Colombia U20 international Edmilson Herazo, 18, of Barranquilla. (Colombian journalist Pipe Sierra)

Paris St-Germain are again interested in 20-year-old Manchester United and France defender Leny Yoro. (KickFootball - in French)
Inter and Juventus are both eyeing Liverpool 's 19-year-old Italian centre-back Giovanni Leoni. (Tuttosport - in Italian)
Real Madrid are considering joining the race to sign Alex Scott after watching the Bournemouth and England midfielder, 23, closely in recent weeks. (Teamtalk)
Chelsea are in pole position to sign Scott from Bournemouth , with Liverpool and Arsenal also interested. (Telegraph - subscription required)

Real Betis will reject any interest in striker Troy Parrott, who has an £85m release clause in his contract, amid talk of a return to Tottenham for the 24-year-old Republic of Ireland international. (Estadio Deportivo - in Spanish)

Manchester United , Arsenal and Chelsea are on a growing list of clubs checking on Freiburg's Croatian striker Igor Matanovic, 23. (Caughtoffside)
Juventus want Liverpool defender Giovanni Leoni, 19, as the Serie A side look to bolster the number of Italian players in their squad. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Newcastle United are open to letting Joe Willock, 27, leave in the January transfer window, with his contract due to run out in the summer and the English midfielder yet to open negotiations over a new deal. (Football Insider)
Tottenham have no plans to sell defender Micky van de Ven, 25, as Liverpool prepare to move for the Netherlands international next year. (Football Insider)

AC Milan are considering a move for Brighton 's Sweden midfielder Yasin Ayari, 22, as a possible replacement for Luka Modric, should the 41-year-old Croatia international choose to retire. (Tuttosport via Football Italia)

Brentford 's Icelandic goalkeeper Hakon Rafn Valdimarsson, 24, would consider leaving the club in the future if first-team opportunities continue to be limited. (RUV - in Icelandic)

Juventus remain keen on Brentford 's 22-year-old Italian right-back Michael Kayode. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Barcelona's Spanish forward Dani Olmo, 28, does not want to leave despite links with Arsenal , Chelsea and clubs in the Saudi Pro-League. (Caughtoffside)

Barcelona are keeping tabs on Italy-born Germany Under-21 striker Nicolo Tresoldi, 22, who continues to impress for Club Brugge . (Sport - in Spanish)
Ex- Manchester City boss Pep Guardiola is planning to attend the club's Champions League game with Paris St-Germain on 14 October in a show of support to his troubled former club. (Express)

Real Madrid are showing an interest in Bayer Leverkusen's 23-year-old England defender Jarell Quansah, who Arsenal made a bid for in the summer and was subject of an enquiry from Chelsea . (Bild - in German)
Mexico's teenage star Gilberto Mora, 17, is on Liverpool 's radar although Borussia Dortmund and Benfica are also keen on the Club Tijuana midfielder. (Teamtalk)

Roma missed out on a loan move for Real Madrid striker Endrick, 20, in the summer but remain interested in signing the Brazil international in January. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

However, the German club played down the prospect of signing Everton and England goalkeeper Jordan Pickford, 32. (TeamTalk)

United are also planning to offer new terms for English defender Luke Shaw, 31, who is out of contract at the end of the season. (Football Insider)
Bayern Munich are also eyeing a move for French defender Jules Kounde, 27, with the player starting the season out of favour at Barcelona (Sport - in Spanish )

Former Manchester United defender Matteo Darmian, 36, is set to begin training with Bologna on Wednesday after his release from Inter Milan at the end of last season ( Gianluca Di Marzio - in Italian )

Bayern Munich are keen on Benfica's 24-year-old Portugal defender Tomas Araujo. (Bild - in German)

Barcelona continue to closely monitor Norway striker Erling Haaland with hopes that the 26-year-old could become a more realistic transfer target in the summer after Manchester City were found guilty of breaking the Premier League's financial rules.​ ‌ ( El Nacional - in Catalan )
